questions.q: In the Equipment Request scenario, why is cmdb_ci the wrong table to extend?
options: cmdb_ci cannot be extended by any custom table
cmdb_ci has no sys_id field
An equipment request is a request for a configuration item, not a configuration item itself
cmdb_ci is reserved only for the Incident table
questions.explain: cmdb_ci represents actual configuration items (like a server or laptop); Equipment Request is a request FOR one, which is task-shaped behavior, not CI-shaped.

questions.q: Why does extending task make sense for the new Equipment Request table?
options: It needs a lifecycle, assignment-group routing, and priority behavior that task already provides, so extending it avoids rebuilding that from scratch
task is required for every custom table regardless of its purpose
Extending task removes the need for a sys_id field
task is the only table that supports reference fields
questions.explain: Equipment Request needs state, assignment_group, and priority behavior — exactly what extending task provides for free, as shown in Lesson 11.

questions.q: What does the planned requested_for field reference, and why?
options: It references cmdb_ci, to track which laptop model exists
It is not a reference field at all, just free text
It references sys_dictionary, to store the field's definition
It references sys_user, to identify which employee the equipment is actually for, since that may differ from who submitted the request
questions.explain: requested_for points at sys_user because an admin might submit the request on someone else's behalf — the requester and the recipient aren't always the same person.

questions.q: Why should equipment_item be a reference field pointing to a catalog table, rather than a free-text field?
options: Free text would be easier to query than a reference field
A reference field stores a clean pointer to exactly which item was chosen, instead of relying on someone to later interpret a free-text description
Reference fields are required on every table by default
Free text fields cannot be displayed on a form
questions.explain: Following the Lesson 13 pattern, a reference field gives a clean, unambiguous pointer to the chosen item rather than an interpretable text description.

questions.q: What is the main point of doing this design planning on paper before opening System Definition > Tables?
options: Paper planning is required by ServiceNow before any table can be created
Reference fields can only be decided after the table already has data in it
The platform does not allow planning any table design in advance
Fixing a wrong Extends table choice after records already exist is far more disruptive than getting the design right first
questions.explain: Working through the extension choice and reference fields on paper first avoids the much higher cost of correcting a wrong structural choice later.
